name: Cosmic Voyage
featureText: Every 🛸 carries ×2, ×3 or ×5. Wilds on a winning line multiply together, up to ×25.

freeSpins.name: Hyperspace Free Spins
freeSpins.text: Every win in hyperspace pays ×3, on top of the 🛸 multipliers.

bonus.name: Warp Ladder
bonus.text: Ride the warp ladder. Every boost climbs a level until the engines cut out. The top pays 1,000×.

jackpot.name: Star Map Wheel
jackpot.text: When 3 🌠 shooting stars land, the Star Map Wheel spins and stops on MINOR, MAJOR or GRAND. The bigger your bet, the better your chance.

collector.name: Fuel Tank
collector.text: Every ⛽ that lands fills the Fuel Tank, shared by all players. The spin that fills the tank starts the Hyperdrive.

reward.name: Hyperdrive
reward.text: 7 free spins with a 🛸 locked in the middle. The multiplier starts at ×1 and rises by 1 after every spin, up to ×10.
